transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Um… I guess what happened at work. I got kind of worked up in a staff meeting and started acting out this fall-prevention drill with chairs and waving my arms around. People were telling me to sit down, but I… I couldn’t really stop right then.
Before that meeting, had you been feeling unusually high or overly energetic?

Yeah… I guess so. I’d been feeling kind of… bright, like charged up, like things were finally clicking. But if somebody slowed me down or questioned me, I’d get irritated fast. Snap more than I meant to.
Have you been hearing or seeing things that other people don’t seem to?
Sometimes, yeah. Like… if I’m by myself in the hallway, or at home near the laundry room, I’ll hear my name. Or like a resident calling for help, real clear. But then I check and… nobody’s there.
Have you felt like you had special powers or a special mission that other people didn’t understand?

Yeah… sort of. I don’t know if I’d call it powers. It’s more like… I get this real strong feeling that I know how to keep the old folks safe better than the supervisors, the people with titles. Like I’m supposed to fix the whole place, if they’d just listen to me.
About how many days in a row were you feeling that charged up before the meeting?
It wasn’t just a couple days. It’s been… on and off like that for months. Maybe close to a year, like eleven months or so. Some stretches I’m just really charged up.
When you hear your name or a resident calling, is that only during the times when you feel especially charged up?

No… not only then. There was a quieter stretch, I guess, where I was sleeping more regular and not running around trying to do all these projects. But even then, for weeks, I’d still hear my name sometimes… and I still felt like people at work were keeping notes on me.
Was there ever a period of at least two weeks when you were hearing things or feeling watched while you were not especially up or irritable?

Yeah… there was. I wasn’t all wound up then, I was sleeping more normal and not doing all those projects. But for a few weeks I still heard my name being called sometimes, and I still thought people at work were keeping notes on me.
